entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
The name is Alex Miller, order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. You received the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor 17 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault. The heart rate is all over the place. Honestly, the product is complete garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having that experience. That's definitely not the quality we aim for. I can try to walk you through a quick sensor recalibration that often fixes that issue. It only takes a minute.
Look, I don't have time for that. I just want money back for this thing. I want a refund, not a science experiment.
I understand completely. You'd prefer to just return it. Let me just review the return eligibility for your order. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked the policy, and since you're within the 90-day return window, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund. No problem at all.
Fine. So you'll send me a label?

Yes, I'm generating that for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email we have on file. Also, I see here that you're a VIP customer with us, Alex. To apologize for the faulty device and the inconvenience, I've added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for you to use on a future order.
Oh. Okay, whatever. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the band back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
